title: IG POST v9.1
desc: v9: legge i commenti con i nodi GeeLark (For Loop Elements + Get element data); il relay (commentbot via ngrok) sceglie quale Reply cliccare; click con ordine da variabile; controllo del nome, 40% e memoria nel relay; END ferma lo scroll a fine commenti.

config.content: sh -c 'dumpsys activity top | grep -q direct_inbox_action_bar && input keyevent 4 || echo home'

config.script: async function main() { return { acc: '', t: '' }; }
async function main({ acc, t }) { const x=String(t||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); return { acc: x ? (String(acc||'') + '\n' + x) : String(acc||''), t: '' }; }
async function main({ acc }) { const e=encodeURIComponent(String(acc||'')).replace(/['()!*]/g, c => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()); return { accEnc: e }; }

async function main({ curlResp }) { const r=String(curlResp||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const no={ goPost:'0', goOn:'1', pickN:'0', tapX:'0', tapY:'0', useTap:'0', ocrAuthor:'', theReply:'' }; if(/^END/.test(r)) return Object.assign(no,{ goOn:'0' }); const p=r.split('|'); if(p[0]!=='PICK'||p.length<6) return no; const x=parseInt(p[2],10)||0, y=parseInt(p[3],10)||0; return { goPost:'1', goOn:'1', pickN: x>0?'0':p[1], tapX:String(x), tapY:String(y), useTap: x>0?'1':'0', ocrAuthor:p[4], theReply:p.slice(5).join('|') }; }
async function main({ prefill }) { const s=String(prefill||'').trim(); const m=/^@([A-Za-z0-9._]{2,30})/.exec(s); return { pfUser: m?('@'+m[1]):'', via: m?'T':'C' }; }

async function main({ confResp }) { let r=String(confResp||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); r=r.replace(/^["']+|["']+$/g,'').trim(); const bad=(!r)||/NO_MATCH/i.test(r)||r.charAt(0)==='{'||r.charAt(0)==='<'||r.length>220; return { goType: bad?'0':'1', finalText: bad?'':r }; }
